name: skywatch
description: A starbase for your Claude Code session: a hazard scale for the context above the prompt, and a pane with the bridge's readings, shields that hold or block risky commands by your directives, a card per shuttle, the mission's totals and a black box.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Comma-separated modules in display order: bridge, plan, council, shields, shuttles, probes, mission, blackbox. Leave one out to hide it. Give each surface its own with app=…; terminal=…

decks.title: Decks
decks.description: Comma-separated Shields decks: file, git, shell, web, agents, app, mcp. A call lands in the first that matches; other takes the rest and is always shown.

autoLaunch.title: Auto launch
autoLaunch.description: Launch the pane when a session starts

hazards.title: Hazards
hazards.description: The hazard scale. viewscreen: a band above the prompt with the last jump; beacon: one short status entry; off: neither. /skywatch hazards changes it for one session.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Colours: skywatch, terminal (the terminal's own 16 colours), claude (Claude Code's theme), catppuccin-mocha, catppuccin-macchiato, catppuccin-frappe, catppuccin-latte, dracula, nord, gruvbox or tokyo-night. Give each surface its own with app=…; terminal=…. ~/.claude/skywatch.palette and the project's .claude/skywatch.palette recolour single parts.
